subject.title: feat(tools): introduce group:core for all built-in core tools

question: Should OpenClaw add a permanent `group:core` public policy alias when `tools.profile: "full"` plus `tools.alsoAllow` already provides the same all-core-plus-selected-plugins composition?
rationale: Both paths are technically viable, but choosing whether to create and maintain a second public configuration contract—especially one that automatically includes future core tools—requires owner intent rather than mechanical repair.

options.title: Keep the existing canonical path
options.body: Remove `group:core`, document `full` plus `alsoAllow`, and avoid a duplicate policy contract.

options.title: Adopt `group:core` deliberately
options.body: Keep the alias only after documenting whether future core tools join automatically and adding compatibility and security coverage for that contract.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the PR open while the tool-policy owner evaluates whether an all-core group has distinct use cases not covered by profiles and additive allowlists.

recommendation.title: Keep the existing canonical path
recommendation.body: Remove `group:core`, document `full` plus `alsoAllow`, and avoid a duplicate policy contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this handle to public configuration and plugin-contract direction decisions.
